source.name: Decidim homepage
source.purpose: Reference structure for content design and page composition. This file is not runtime page content.

contentDesignPrinciples: Treat the landing as a composition of reusable editorial blocks, not a single React page.
Let Payload own page content, order, drafts, preview and localization.
Let Next own routing, server rendering and block component rendering.
Keep the JSON as a reference for editorial structure and block taxonomy.
Each block should have one editorial job and a predictable rendering component.

structuralPattern.purpose: Expose primary paths before the civic claim.
State the category, project name and civic promise in the first viewport.
Show principles or adoption signals immediately after the hero.
Use one large preview area with a navigable capability list.
Condense the project philosophy into one strong sentence.
Show the first complete civic journey rather than abstract claims only.
Describe how hub, specs, UI package and independent module repositories relate.
Surface roadmap, specs updates and contribution paths.
